question: Which figure should replace the question mark to complete the series?

why: Figure 1 is a closed curved shape (circle) and figure 2 is an open curved line (wave). Figure 3 is a closed straight-line shape (triangle), so figure 4 must be an open straight line that copies the wave: a low zig-zag going down, up, down, up. That is option 4. Options 1 and 2 are only one bend, and option 3 is too tall and starts at the top.
trick: Pair the figures: 1 goes with 2 and 3 goes with 4 (closed shape, then its open line).
